mapper.select: SELECT R.ID AS reservationId, R.CODE AS reservationCode, R.GUEST_ID AS guestId, R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, C.NAME AS guestName, R.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount, R.CHECKIN AS checkin, R.CHECKOUT AS checkout, RT.NAME AS roomTypeName, RM.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, R.REQUEST AS memo FROM RESERVATION R JOIN CUSTOMER C ON R.GUEST_ID = C.ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON R.ROOM_TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN ROOM RM ON R.ROOM_ID = RM.ID WHERE TRUNC(R.CHECKIN) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND R.STATUS = '예약완료' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHECKIN_STATUS CS WHERE CS.RESERVATION_ID = R.ID ) ORDER BY R.CHECKIN ASC

SELECT CS.ID AS id, CS.RESERVATION_ID AS reservationId, CS.GUEST_ID AS guestId, CS.ROOM_ID AS roomId, CS.CHECKIN AS checkin, CS.CHECKOUT AS checkout, CS.KEY_TYPE AS keyType, CS.CHECKIN_EMPLOYEE AS checkinEmployee, CS.CHECKOUT_EMPLOYEE AS checkoutEmployee, CS.MEMO AS memo, C.NAME AS guestName, R.CODE AS reservationCode, RM.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, RT.NAME AS roomTypeName, R.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount FROM CHECKIN_STATUS CS JOIN RESERVATION R ON CS.RESERVATION_ID = R.ID JOIN CUSTOMER C ON CS.GUEST_ID = C.ID JOIN ROOM RM ON CS.ROOM_ID = RM.ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON RM.TYPE_ID = RT.ID WHERE TRUNC(R.CHECKOUT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND CS.CHECKOUT IS NULL ORDER BY R.CHECKOUT ASC

SELECT CS.ID AS id, R.ID AS reservationId, R.CODE AS reservationCode, R.GUEST_ID AS guestId, NVL(CS.ROOM_ID, R.ROOM_ID) AS roomId, C.NAME AS guestName, R.GUEST_COUNT AS guestCount, R.CHECKIN AS checkin, R.CHECKOUT AS checkout, RT.NAME AS roomTypeName, RM.ROOM_NUM AS roomNum, CS.KEY_TYPE AS keyType, CS.CHECKIN_EMPLOYEE AS checkinEmployee, CS.CHECKOUT_EMPLOYEE AS checkoutEmployee, NVL(CS.MEMO, R.REQUEST) AS memo FROM RESERVATION R JOIN CUSTOMER C ON R.GUEST_ID = C.ID JOIN ROOM_TYPE RT ON R.ROOM_TYPE_ID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN CHECKIN_STATUS CS ON R.ID = CS.RESERVATION_ID LEFT JOIN ROOM RM ON RM.ID = NVL(CS.ROOM_ID, R.ROOM_ID) WHERE R.ID = #{reservationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHECKIN_STATUS (ID, RESERVATION_ID, GUEST_ID, ROOM_ID, CHECKIN, KEY_TYPE, CHECKIN_EMPLOYEE, MEMO) VALUES (CHECKIN_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{reservationId}, #{guestId}, #{roomId}, SYSDATE, #{keyType}, #{checkinEmployee}, #{memo})
